commits.summary: Queue a Bitwuzla 0.8.2 build from source for the solver comparison (verification pending)
Count class initializers by shape: enums and their switch maps are all the apps have (Phase 4b)
Link CaDiCaL static into the Bitwuzla build and queue it again (verification pending)
Run application class initializers in the own checker, as JVMS 5.5 does (Phase 5, step 1)
Model Enum.<init>, List.of and List.copyOf for JBMC, checked on the JVM (Phase 5, step 2; verification pending)
Record the own checker's solver calls as replayable incremental CNF transcripts (Phase 6a)
